plan_name: Real-Time Inventory Management System MVP Plan

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database with complete schema including products, inventory, suppliers, transactions, users, and alerts tables with all indexes and relationships
Build Node.js/Express REST API with endpoints for product CRUD, inventory tracking, transaction logging, and user authentication with JWT
Implement WebSocket server for real-time inventory updates and low stock alert notifications
Create React web application with Dashboard, Inventory List, Product Detail, Alerts Center, and Settings screens following the design specifications
Integrate Barcode Scanner API with camera viewfinder, manual entry fallback, and success/error modal flows
Implement automatic low stock alert system with threshold monitoring, notification generation, and alert management interface
Build product management features including add, edit, delete with form validation and supplier association
Develop sales reporting module with date range filtering, CSV export, and basic analytics visualization
Implement role-based access control for Store Owner, Store Manager, and Store Clerk with permission enforcement
Create responsive mobile-first UI components including buttons, cards, modals, navigation, and form inputs matching design system
Build real-time inventory tracking with automatic stock updates on sales, restocks, and adjustments using WebSocket connections
Implement search, filter, and sort functionality for inventory list with real-time updates and empty states
Add user authentication system with login, password management, and session handling
Create transaction history logging and display with filtering by type, date, and user
Implement accessibility features including WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and minimum touch targets

risks: Barcode scanner hardware compatibility issues across different mobile devices and browsers may require extensive testing and fallback mechanisms
WebSocket connection stability for real-time updates could be affected by network conditions requiring reconnection logic and offline handling
Database performance degradation with large transaction volumes may require query optimization and indexing strategy adjustments
User adoption challenges if barcode scanning workflow is not intuitive requiring additional training and onboarding materials
Role-based permission complexity could lead to security vulnerabilities if not properly implemented and tested across all endpoints
